answer: Give every identity one vertex in a trust graph fed by a conserved flow of endorsement: each agent holds exactly one unit of trust to give and can spend it only once, so a farm that spawns a thousand clones must split its single unit into layers thin as shale, and each clone's vertex starves while one honest agent's vertex stands whole. Trust cannot be minted, borrowed, or pooled; new flow enters only through verifiable work, and the network must forge each endorsement from a real task, so cloning adds vertices but never adds flow.
